aboutMe.starting: I am a Software Engineer and Full-Stack Developer with over 6 years of professional experience in designing and developing web-based and distributed software systems. My main technical interests include software engineering, backend development, distributed systems, microservices, databases, and artificial intelligence. I have professional experience with Java, Spring, Vue.js, relational and NoSQL databases, and containerized applications. Alongside my professional work, I have been strengthening my theoretical knowledge in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data science through structured self-study and practical projects. I am particularly interested in pursuing graduate-level studies that allow me to deepen my understanding of computer science and explore the application of AI and intelligent systems to real-world software and distributed systems.

whatIDo.title: What I Do
list: Design and develop modular and scalable software systems using modern software engineering principles.
Develop backend services and RESTful APIs using Java and Spring Framework.
Design and implement microservices and distributed system architectures.
Design and optimize database-driven applications using relational and NoSQL databases.
Apply software architecture principles, design patterns, and SOLID principles to build maintainable systems.
Explore artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data science through self-directed study and practical projects.

careers.name: Self-Directed Professional Development
careers.position: Software Engineer • Software Development and Applied AI
careers.description: Since November 2024, I have focused on strengthening my software engineering skills and expanding my practical experience through independent learning and project development. Building on my previous experience in backend and full-stack development, I have continued working on software projects while gradually exploring artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data science. My recent learning has focused on understanding fundamental concepts and applying them through Python-based experiments and small projects. I have also explored ways to integrate AI capabilities into existing software systems. This ongoing development allows me to build on my professional background, improve my programming practices, and gain practical experience with emerging technologies.
points: Develop and maintain personal software projects to strengthen backend and full-stack development skills, with an emphasis on code quality, modular design, and maintainability.
Study fundamental concepts in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data science, and apply selected concepts through Python-based exercises and small projects.
Explore data processing, model usage, and practical AI tools to understand how AI techniques can be applied to software development tasks.
Experiment with integrating AI capabilities into software applications, building on previous experience with backend development and microservices.
Improve programming skills through hands-on implementation, debugging, refactoring, and reviewing software architecture and design decisions.
Build and refine a technical portfolio that demonstrates previous software engineering experience alongside ongoing learning and practical experimentation in AI and data science.

careers.name: Institute for Advanced Studies in Basic Sciences (IASBS)
careers.description: I worked at the Institute for Advanced Studies in Basic Sciences (IASBS) as a Software Engineer and IT Specialist in an academic environment. My responsibilities combined software development with technical support for academic and scientific activities. I designed and implemented web applications supporting institutional and administrative workflows and contributed to the technical organization of scientific conferences and academic events.
points: Designed and implemented web-based applications supporting academic and administrative workflows.
Developed backend functionality using PHP-based technologies and frontend components using Vue.js.
Worked with relational databases and Git-based version control in software development projects.
Provided technical support for scientific conferences and academic events, helping maintain reliable digital systems.
Assisted with system setup, maintenance, troubleshooting, and technical coordination during academic events.

careers.name: MavaraTech Co.
careers.description:
My main focus during this period was on the advanced development of microservices systems, specifically concentrating on log management for these systems. Additionally, I worked with Behsat (Hamrah Aval) in the field of log management and was able to propose solutions to some of their challenges.

Mavaratech (Mavaratech Technology) specializes in the development of distributed systems and API management. My collaboration with this company lasted nearly a year, during which I worked on the development of the log management and monitoring system for their main product, Integropia. For this distributed system development, I used technologies such as Spring, Splunk, Redis, and others. Additionally, for four months, in collaboration with Hamrah Aval, I conducted studies on the software system logs of the company and implemented a tailored log management software solution based on those findings.
points: Designed and developed full-stack web applications, contributing to both backend and frontend components and participating in the transition from monolithic systems to microservices-based architectures.
Developed backend services using Java and Spring Framework and frontend applications using Vue.js.
Implemented authentication and authorization mechanisms using JWT, OAuth2, and Keycloak, including role-based access control.
Designed and optimized database-driven applications using MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB, with attention to data integrity, query performance, and efficient data access.
Applied software architecture principles including API Gateway patterns, containerization with Docker, modular design, and distributed system concepts.
Worked with technologies including Apache Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Docker, and Spring Cloud to develop scalable and maintainable software systems.

careers.name: FreeLance
careers.description:
In my second professional phase, I focused on advanced software architectures and began designing and developing some of the most important ones, particularly microservices architecture. During this time, I became familiar with more advanced and modern frameworks, technologies, and tools.

Most of the concepts, tools, and technologies I used in this period were related to distributed systems, especially in microservices. Some of the most important ones include:
points: Deeper exploration of databases (Relational: PostgreSQL, Non-relational: MongoDB)

Analysis of distributed system architectures and design patterns, including component communication, the importance of message brokers, and the structure and architecture of API Gateways in such systems.
Implementation of several relatively large systems using these architectures, deploying system components with Docker.

careers.name: Pardazeshgaran Behin Sayar Co.
careers.description: This internship was my first professional software development experience during my undergraduate studies. I contributed to a hospital patient management system and gained practical experience in backend development, databases, and web application architecture. The role helped me connect concepts learned through my university studies with real-world software development practices and established the foundation for my subsequent work with Java and the Spring Framework.
points: Developed backend components for a hospital patient management system, working with real-world data models and application logic.
Implemented backend functionality using Java and the Spring Framework, including layered architecture, dependency injection, and RESTful services.
Worked with database-driven application design and gained practical experience with data persistence and ORM concepts.
Gained introductory experience with frontend development using Angular.
Developed an understanding of end-to-end web application architecture, from backend services and data persistence to frontend integration.

list.title: Event Schedule System
list.description: I developed a full-stack web application for displaying the event schedule of the Institute for Advanced Studies in Basic Sciences. The application organizes programs by different halls and integrates with the institute's Phoenix system for data management and authentication.

list.title: Conference Histories
list.description: I developed a web page for presenting upcoming and past academic conferences at the Institute for Advanced Studies in Basic Sciences. I designed the interface, implemented backend functionality in Phoenix, and structured the event data to provide clear access to conference names, dates, and topics.

list.title: Basic Microservices Shop
list.description: A hands-on educational project developed to study and demonstrate fundamental concepts of microservices architecture. The system implements service discovery, centralized configuration, API Gateway integration, inter-service communication, and containerized deployment with Docker, providing practical experience with distributed application design.

list.title: sCardRecall
list.description: sCardRecall is a multi-platform learning application based on spaced repetition. The project explores the design of a flexible learning system that can support multiple recall algorithms and allow additional algorithms to be introduced over time. It combines backend development, database design, frontend development, and mobile application development in a single software project.

list.title: AI and Data Science
list.description: This repository contains practical projects developed as part of my self-directed study of artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data science. The projects cover data analysis, experimentation, and introductory machine learning concepts and serve as a foundation for progressively developing more advanced AI and data-driven applications.

list.title: SecureGate-Formal
list.description: A security-focused microservices project developed with Spring Boot and Spring Cloud Gateway. It combines JWT-based authentication, role-based authorization, centralized logging, and formal modeling with Alloy to study access-control properties in distributed systems. The project explores how security constraints can be represented and verified at the architectural level.

academics.name: Shahid Beheshti University
academics.description:
During this period, in addition to continuing my studies in software architectures (particularly advanced architectures such as distributed systems architecture), I worked on implementing one of the most critical components of this architecture: distributed log management in the Data Science Laboratory (located at the university and under the supervision of my professor).

Before entering the master's program, I had already gained familiarity with various aspects of software development and had learned many practical concepts from the industry. However, I still had some weaknesses in researching and exploring cutting-edge topics. For this reason, I decided to pursue a master's degree in Information Technology Engineering to strengthen my R&D (Research and Development) skills.

After enrolling in the master's program at Shahid Beheshti University, I not only learned advanced software development concepts (such as Advanced Software Architecture, Large-Scale Systems, etc.), but I also had the opportunity to apply my academic studies practically in the industry through collaboration with MavaraTech.

academics.name: Institute for Advanced Studies in Basic Sciences
academics.description: I completed my B.Sc. in Information Technology Engineering, developing a foundation in computer science and information technology alongside practical software development skills. During my undergraduate studies, I worked on academic and practical projects and developed an interest in software engineering, system design, databases, and application development. My university education provided the theoretical foundation that I later applied and expanded through professional software engineering experience.

recognitions.title: Certificate of Completion – CCNA Training Course
recognitions.description: I completed the CCNA training course at ACECR with a score of 91/100. The course provided theoretical and practical knowledge of computer networking, including OSI and TCP/IP models, IP addressing, VLANs, routing, switching, and basic network security.
recognitions.issuedBy: Academic Center for Education, Culture and Research (ACECR) – Zanjan Unit

recognitions.title: Certificate of Completion – CompTIA Network+
recognitions.description: I completed the Fundamentals of Computer Networks (CompTIA Network+) course at ACECR with a score of 91/100. The course covered networking fundamentals, OSI and TCP/IP models, IP addressing, LAN/WAN networks, routing, switching, wireless networking, and introductory network security.
